mainEntity.name: What is enterprise AI PR and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Enterprise AI PR is the work of positioning an AI company to be credible in the rooms where enterprise purchasing decisions are made: analyst briefings, trade publications read by CIOs and procurement leads, customer co-announcements and founder authority pieces in outlets like Forbes and VentureBeat. It is for AI startups that have a product selling to enterprise accounts and need coverage that moves buyers, not just community attention. Shilika Jain runs this work directly for AI startup clients at $5K–$12K/month.

mainEntity.name: How much does enterprise AI PR cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full-service agency running enterprise AI PR typically charges $15K–$45K per month, because the retainer funds a multi-person account team that may or may not have direct analyst relationships. A fractional senior operator delivers the same scope, with senior hands on every briefing and pitch, for $5K–$12K per month. A focused launch sprint around a product announcement or fundraise runs $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets and analysts can you actually reach?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trade press: Forbes, VentureBeat, The Information, Wired, TechCrunch, Benzinga, AI Magazine. Analyst briefings are placed with Gartner, Forrester and independent AI analysts whose reports circulate in enterprise procurement cycles. Podcast placements cover AI-focused shows with builder and investor audiences. Every outlet depends on a real news hook and genuine category positioning, not a wire blast or a paid placement.

mainEntity.name: What does the process look like and how long does it take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first two weeks cover a narrative audit: current press footprint, analyst standing, customer proof assets and the positioning thesis. Week three begins outreach, with analyst briefings and trade press pitches timed to your product or fundraise moment. Sustained coverage and AI-citation tracking run from month two onward. Most clients see the first tier-1 placement within four to six weeks of kick-off.
